cards.ex: The older generation often laments the moral decay they see in today's youth.
cards.exUz: Katta avlod ko'pincha bugungi yoshlarda ko'rayotgan axloqiy tanazzuldan shikoyat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda axloqiy me'yorlar va qadriyatlarning asta-sekin yo'qolishi, buzilishi.

cards.ex: Our company's code of ethics strictly prohibits accepting gifts from clients.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamizning axloq kodeksi mijozlardan sovg'alar qabul qilishni qat'iyan taqiqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan guruh yoki tashkilot uchun qabul qilingan axloqiy qoidalar va tamoyillar to'plami.

cards.ex: His ethical lapse cost him his job and reputation.
cards.exUz: Uning axloqiy xatosi unga ishi va obro'sidan ayrilishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy me'yorlarni buzish, odob doirasidan chiqish.

cards.ex: He had no moral scruples about exploiting his workers.
cards.exUz: Uning o'z ishchilarini ekspluatatsiya qilishda hech qanday axloqiy shubhasi yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy sabablarga ko'ra biror narsadan shubhalanish, ikkilanish.

cards.ex: It's important to uphold integrity, even when no one is watching.
cards.exUz: Hech kim kuzatmayotgan bo'lsa ham, halollikni saqlash muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: O'zining halolligini va to'g'riligini himoya qilish va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: History will judge those who stood on the wrong side of the civil rights movement.
cards.exUz: Tarix fuqarolik huquqlari harakatining noto'g'ri tomonida turganlarni hukm qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan noto'g'ri bo'lgan tomonda turish.

cards.ex: Moral relativism argues that there are no universal moral truths.
cards.exUz: Axloqiy nisbiylik universal axloqiy haqiqatlar yo'q deb ta'kidlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy qadriyatlar har xil jamiyatlarda har xil bo'lishi mumkin degan qarash.

cards.ex: The investigation uncovered widespread unethical behavior within the company.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv kompaniya ichida keng tarqalgan axloqsiz xatti-harakatlarni aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy me'yorlarga zid bo'lgan xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: His personal moral code forbade him from lying, even to protect himself.
cards.exUz: Uning shaxsiy axloq qoidalari hatto o'zini himoya qilish uchun ham yolg'on gapirishni taqiqlagan.
cards.uzDef: Insonning xatti-harakatlarini boshqaradigan axloqiy tamoyillar to'plami.

cards.ex: After betraying his friend, he had a crisis of conscience.
cards.exUz: Do'stiga xiyonat qilgandan so'ng, u vijdon azobini his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan noto'g'ri bo'lgan harakatdan keyin kuchli afsuslanish hissi.

cards.ex: The company is committed to maintaining the highest ethical standards.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya eng yuqori axloqiy me'yorlarni saqlashga sodiqdir.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakatlar uchun qabul qilingan axloqiy qoidalar va tamoyillar.

cards.ex: His affair was a moral failing that cost him his marriage.
cards.exUz: Uning ishqiy munosabatlari unga nikohidan ayrilishiga sabab bo'lgan axloqiy kamchilik edi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy me'yorlarga javob bermaslik, xato qilish.

cards.ex: She refused to lie, adhering to her strong moral principles.
cards.exUz: U kuchli axloqiy tamoyillariga amal qilib, yolg'on gapirishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Insonning xatti-harakatlarini boshqaradigan asosiy axloqiy e'tiqodlar.

cards.ex: The investigation revealed several serious ethical violations.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv bir nechta jiddiy axloqiy buzilishlarni aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy qoidalarni yoki me'yorlarni buzish.

cards.ex: Doctors have an ethical obligation to protect patient confidentiality.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar bemorning maxfiyligini himoya qilishga axloqiy majburiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lgan narsani qilishga bo'lgan burch.

cards.ex: He took a strong moral stance against the war.
cards.exUz: U urushga qarshi kuchli axloqiy pozitsiyani egalladi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan masala bo'yicha axloqiy nuqtai nazar, qarash.

cards.ex: It's infuriating that he got off scot-free after lying under oath.
cards.exUz: U qasamyod ostida yolg'on gapirgandan keyin jazolanmasdan qutulib qolgani g'azabni keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki jinoyat uchun jazolanmasdan qutulib qolish.

cards.ex: Her honesty was beyond reproach; everyone trusted her completely.
cards.exUz: Uning halolligi tanqidga tobe emas edi; hamma unga to'liq ishongan.
cards.uzDef: Tanqid qilinmaydigan, hech qanday aybi yo'q.

cards.ex: Even when it was difficult, she always stuck to her principles.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lgan taqdirda ham, u har doim o'z tamoyillariga sodiq qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z axloqiy tamoyillariga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: He made a Faustian bargain to get to the top, sacrificing his friends along the way.
cards.exUz: U tepaga chiqish uchun Foustian kelishuviga erishdi va shu yo'lda do'stlarini qurbon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyat yoki qudratga erishish uchun axloqiy jihatdan qimmat to'lov to'lash.

cards.ex: The critic did a hatchet job on the new movie, calling it a complete disaster.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchi yangi filmni qattiq tanqid qildi va uni butunlay falokat deb atadi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni qattiq va shafqatsizlarcha tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: The lack of accountability allowed the corruption to spread.
cards.exUz: Javobgarlikning yo'qligi korrupsiyaning tarqalishiga imkon berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikni his qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The novel explores the depths of moral depravity in wartime.
cards.exUz: Roman urush davridagi axloqiy buzuqlikning tubini o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy axloqiy buzilish, tubanlik.

cards.ex: Companies have an ethical responsibility to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar atrof-muhitni himoya qilishga axloqiy mas'uliyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lgan narsani qilishga bo'lgan majburiyat.

cards.ex: The public expressed moral outrage at the politician's corruption.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik siyosatchining korrupsiyasidan axloqiy g'azabini bildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqsiz xatti-harakatga nisbatan kuchli g'azab va norozilik hissi.

cards.ex: The scandal has weakened the moral fabric of the community.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal jamiyatning axloqiy to'qimasini zaiflashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning axloqiy qadriyatlari va tamoyillari majmui; jamiyatning axloqi.

cards.ex: He seems to have lost his ethical compass somewhere along the way.
cards.exUz: U yo'l davomida o'zining axloqiy kompasini yo'qotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning to'g'ri va noto'g'ri xatti-harakatni aniqlashga yordam beradigan ichki yo'l-yo'rig'i.

cards.ex: The journalist found himself in an ethical quandary when he discovered the source of the leak.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist o'zini axloqiy chalkashlikda topdi, qachonki u sizdirish manbasini topdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin va noaniq axloqiy vaziyat; dilemma.

cards.ex: We need to consider the moral implications of this technology before it's widely adopted.
cards.exUz: Ushbu texnologiya keng qo'llanilishidan oldin uning axloqiy oqibatlarini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakat yoki qarorning axloqiy ta'siri yoki natijalari.

cards.ex: The manager knew about the theft but chose to look the other way.
cards.exUz: Menejer o'g'irlik haqida bilar edi, lekin ko'z yumishni tanladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning noto'g'ri ishini bilib turib, unga e'tibor bermaslik.
